author: Vox
description:
The trial of Lindsey Clancy, the mother accused of killing her three children in Massachusetts, has stirred conversation over the treatment of postpartum depression. While Clancy’s case is distinctly rare and involves potential postpartum psychosis, postpartum depression is remarkably common. 

Vox’s Dylan Scott reached out to organizations across the country that are offering effective treatment with a simple approach: peer support from other women.

Learn more: https://www.vox.com/health/501565/lindsay-clancy-trial-postpartum-depression-psychosis

author: Vox
description:
Wild horses are an iconic fixture of the American West, yet every year the government rounds up thousands for adoption. But according to a recent New York Times investigation, some are sent to slaughter — a problem that's only getting worse under the Trump administration. Vox’s Kenny Torrella explains why.

author: Vox
description:
Meta’s new teen-safety rules depend on knowing who’s under 18. That could mean ID checks, AI facial scans, and less online anonymity for everyone. WIRED senior writer Paresh Dave explains why protecting teenagers could also create new privacy and free-expression risks.

author: Vox
description:
Twenty-seven Republican-controlled states have imposed measures to restrict trans athletes from playing in girls’ and women’s sports since 2020, but this November will be the first time voters have a chance to weigh in on the question directly. Ballot measures are appearing this year in Washington, Arizona, Colorado and Nebraska. 

But Washington’s goes further than any other state in one key way: it would apply to all students seeking to play girls’ sports, not just athletes whose eligibility has been challenged.

The initiative, I-638, would require every girl to prove their sex assigned at birth, via “only one or more of the following: the student's reproductive anatomy, genetic makeup, or normal endogenously produced testosterone levels.”
